title: Curved moving walls must be mass conserving; torque anchors must not use the local momentum-exchange sum on staircase walls
statement: Any rotating/moving-wall case whose wall is not lattice aligned must report the measured relative mass drift together with the result; ForcedD3Q19 must be constructed with mass_conserving_walls=True (the default) for such walls; a torque anchor for a curved wall must be obtained from the profile identity T(r)=2*pi*rho*nu*L*r^2*(du_theta/dr - u_theta/r) and not from the local Ladd momentum-exchange sum.
rationale: Measured in campaign node p158w2-n01 (TensorLBM): the naive Ladd moving-wall bounce-back injects mass at the axis-crossing corner nodes of a staircase circle. The net injection over the wall is zero but its node-wise pattern is dominated by the m=2 harmonic, which drives a spurious m=2 secondary flow: relative mass drift 2.59e-2 and profile error 13.8 % (interior) / 59.4 % (nominal) in D3Q19, against 1.1 % profile error for the same parameters in D2Q9. The per-node weighted-mean correction (mass_conserving_walls) removes the drift (1.7e-13) but not the momentum slip. Separately, the Ladd momentum-exchange torque on a coarse staircase circle is dominated by the non-cancelling pressure part (|T| ~ 1e2 for an analytic torque of 0.72), so it cannot serve as an anchor there.

validator.version: pinned by the TensorLBM project environment

fixtures.positive: tests/test_rotating_duct.py::test_plane_couette_moving_wall_exact (lattice-aligned moving wall: profile exact to 1e-3 and mass conserved), ::test_annulus_geometry_and_wall_velocity (wall velocity = omega x r, tangential), ::test_couette_analytic_profile_and_torque_identity (torque identity matches 4*pi*mu*L*|B| and is r-independent).
fixtures.negative: tests/test_rotating_duct.py::test_secondary_diagnostics_single_cell_is_rejected (a single-cell field must not be reported as a vortex pair) and the D3Q19 staircase limitation recorded in benchmarks/verified/rotating_duct_frame_w2/records/rotating_duct_frame_w2.json under known_limitation.

acceptance.mass_drift: reported for every moving-wall case and <= 1e-6 for lattice-aligned walls of the D3Q19 kernel
acceptance.torque_anchor: |torque_from_profile / (4*pi*mu*L*|B|) - 1| <= 0.03, with the r-spread of T(r) reported alongside
acceptance.couette_anchor: the Taylor-Couette verification uses the D2Q9 annulus (RotatingAnnulusD2Q9) as long as the D3Q19 staircase moving wall keeps its spurious momentum slip

remediation: Construct ForcedD3Q19 with mass_conserving_walls=True for curved walls, record mass_drift in the benchmark record, and use the profile torque identity; do not promote a D3Q19 curved-moving-wall result to verified until an interpolated (Bouzidi-type) or otherwise slip-free wall treatment is implemented and demonstrated.
